name: VM Chat Reaction
description: One person's one emoji on one message. A standalone doctype rather than a child table of VM Chat Message, because a reaction is a single-row insert or delete on a hot path — routing it through the message document would mean loading and re-saving the whole message, and its version history, every time somebody taps a thumbs-up.

fields.label: Room
fields.description: Denormalised from the message so a room's reactions can be swept without joining.
